# content at compile time; updating this file alone will NOT change
# rule_mixed_cn_en behaviour unless and until the helper code is updated
# to read it at runtime (also TODO in M5).
#
# Future file-format: same plain-text, one English token per line,
# case-insensitive, ignoring blank lines and '#'-prefixed comments.
